highlights_headline: The v3 previews introduce Skia m116 and expand accelerated drawing across desktop and mobile views.
highlights_body: WinUI gains accelerated panels, Mac Catalyst uses Metal, and WPF gains SKGLElement. New picture, shader, and pixel-access APIs accompany a substantial migration from the 2.88 API surface.

breaking.title: Replace removed legacy APIs before upgrading
breaking.body: Previously obsolete APIs and types are removed. Replace legacy GPU descriptors with GRBackendTexture or GRBackendRenderTarget, use SKSurfaceProperties instead of SKSurfaceProps, and move text-blob construction to SKFont-based overloads. Rebuild consumers against v3 and use the linked API diffs for the remaining replacements.

breaking.title: Migrate unsupported UWP and watchOS applications
breaking.body: UWP and watchOS support is removed. Keep those applications on a compatible older release or move them to a supported platform before adopting v3.

breaking.title: Treat SKMatrix44 as a value
breaking.body: SKMatrix44 is now a value type, not a disposable SKObject. Remove disposal and reference-identity assumptions, replace removed mutating methods with the current matrix APIs, and use TryInvert(out ...) for inversion. Review ref-based matrix call sites against the API diff.

breaking.title: Update filter and runtime-effect construction
breaking.body: SKImageFilter.CropRect and older filter overloads are removed; migrate to current overloads using SKRect where applicable. Runtime shaders use SKRuntimeEffect.CreateShader instead of Create, and ToShader no longer accepts isOpaque. JPEG, PNG, and WebP option properties lose setters; construct configured options rather than assigning properties afterward.

breaking.title: Update view subclasses and WinForms OpenGL integration
breaking.body: Replace removed Android OnDraw/OnDrawFrame and Apple DrawInSurface overrides with OnPaintSurface, and use PaintSurface rather than SetRenderer. MAUI canvas controller interfaces are removed. SKGLControl moves to the newer OpenTK GLControl base and drops the GraphicsMode constructors; update custom initialization accordingly.

bullets.detail: The preview line moves the bundled renderer to Skia milestone 116.
Adds SKBlender, SKImage.ToRawShader, Skottie animation-builder bindings, and SKPicture playback and size APIs. Picture recording also gains an R-tree overload.
Adds offset-based GetPixelSpan access, Span-based color-filter and rounded-rectangle helpers, SKFilterQuality compatibility overloads, and Blazor component DPI access.

bullets.lead: Accelerated views on more UI stacks
bullets.detail: WinUI gains ANGLE-backed SKSwapChainPanel and native assets, Mac Catalyst switches to Metal, and WPF adds SKGLElement. Metal APIs are also exposed from a common .NET target.
Native builds add Emscripten 3.1.56 for .NET 9, while non-SIMD variants remain available for browser configurations that need them.

Fixes magenta Metal snapshots, MAUI view memory leaks, disposal of cloned paints, and Uno canvas color format and resize-background behavior. Unloaded Uno canvases also handle a missing XamlRoot safely.

Restores the 2.88.8 PNG encoding behavior, honors paint filter quality in obsolete sampling overloads, fixes kerning-pair adjustments, and rounds rectangle conversions outward so partial edges are not truncated.

contributor_summaries.jeromelaban: Uno rendering and unload fixes, non-SIMD browser assets, and .NET 9 WebAssembly support.
contributor_summaries.maxkatz6: Trimming support, cross-target Metal APIs, and source-generated native interop.
contributor_summaries.Youssef1313: Uno pixel formats, rounded-rectangle Span overloads, and filter-quality compatibility APIs.
contributor_summaries.jeremy-visionaid: Crash fix when disposing cloned paints.
contributor_summaries.lindexi: Removal of async-void rendering in SKXamlCanvas.
contributor_summaries.sungaila: Restoration of compatible PNG encoder behavior.

preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.1.8: Opened the v3 line with WinUI accelerated views, offset pixel spans, and the removal of legacy APIs and unsupported platforms.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.2.1: Added Skottie animation-builder bindings and raw image shaders, and switched Mac Catalyst rendering to Metal.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.3.1: Added WPF SKGLElement and Blazor DPI exposure, exposed Metal APIs across .NET targets, and fixed Metal snapshot colors.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.4.1: Moved to Skia m116 and added SKBlender and picture playback APIs. Corrected cloned-paint disposal and Uno rendering behavior.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.5.4: Added .NET 9 WebAssembly assets and source-generated interop, fixed MAUI view leaks, and restored PNG encoding compatibility.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp adopts function pointers and LibraryImport interop alongside the refreshed .NET target setup. Legacy obsolete binding APIs are removed as part of the v3 modernization.
